entities.summary: Tonga, a notable figure in the history of Fiji, associated with Pre-Contact Fijian Chiefdoms (900–1600). Preceded by Tongan Influence in Eastern Fiji and Fijian Chiefdom System. Their legacy influenced Fortified Ring-Ditch Villages.
